description:
Create or update one post (a blog post under /content and/or a newsletter email), keyed by slug: an existing slug is updated, a new one is created as a draft. Same as `micropage posts push` for one file; the arguments are the post front-matter fields plus body_markdown (see the micropage://posts/format resource).

Every call replaces the whole post: an omitted optional field (description, hero, subject, preview, email/list) is cleared. The exception is `date` (the post's public date, past or today): omitted, the post keeps its current date. To edit, read the post with list_posts(slug) first and pass everything back, with its `revision`: if the post changed since that read (in the editor, the CLI or another session), the save is refused with REVISION_CONFLICT and nothing is written; re-read it, merge, and save again.

Saving never sends email and never publishes a draft. But if the post is already published, the save changes the live page at once and rebuilds the site, so it needs confirm_live_update: true after the user agrees. The site rebuild redeploys the live build, so an unpublished page draft left by save_page or the editor stays a draft. It returns build_id and after_event_id to follow the rebuild with get_deploy_status. When every field already matches the saved post (a date that keeps the current one counts as matching), nothing is written, no rebuild is queued, no confirmation is needed, and action is "unchanged".

Images are not uploaded here. For the hero pass an https URL or the filename of an asset uploaded with upload_asset; inside body_markdown use hosted URLs only (upload_asset, then get_file_url). To publish afterwards use preview_post_send, then publish_post.

body_markdown.description: Post body in Markdown. Images must already be hosted URLs: upload each image with upload_asset, get its URL with get_file_url, and write ![alt](https://...). Local paths are not uploaded here and would 404.

confirm_live_update.description: Required (true) when the post is already published: saving then changes the live page at once and rebuilds the site. Ask the user before setting it.

date.description: Public date of the post, YYYY-MM-DD (midnight UTC) or ISO 8601 (2026-10-01T09:30:00Z; no offset means UTC). Sets the published date; past or today only (scheduling is not supported). On a draft it is held until the first publish. Unlike the other optional fields, omitting it leaves the post's date unchanged.

description.description: Web summary for the /content archive, meta description and og tags. Omitted clears it.

email.description: true makes the post an email to `list` when it is published (saving never sends). Default false: web only.

hero.description: Hero image: an https URL, or the filename of an asset already uploaded to this project (call upload_asset first for a new image). Omitted clears it.

list.description: Newsletter form name to send to (case-insensitive exact match). Required with email: true; only allowed with it.

project.description: Which project: its uuid, its numeric id, its micropage hostname ("acme" or "acme.micropage.sh") or its custom domain ("www.acme.com"). A full URL also works. Get valid values from list_projects.

revision.description: The revision from list_posts; pass it when editing an existing post so a change made since your read is not overwritten. 0 means the post must not exist yet. Omitted, the post's revision at save time is used.

slug.description: URL slug, unique per project; the post lives at /content/<slug>. Defaults to the slugified title. The slug picks which post is updated: an existing slug updates that post, a new one creates a post.

subject.description: Email subject. Defaults to the title.

visibility.description: listed (default): shown in the site's /content index. unlisted: has a page but is not listed.

name: upsert_post

action.description: unchanged: every field already matched the saved post, so nothing was written and no rebuild was queued.

after_event_id.description: Pass to get_deploy_status with build_id to see only events from this rebuild.

build_id.description: The build the site rebuild redeploys: the live one, not an unpublished page draft. Pass to get_deploy_status; null when nothing was rebuilt.

published.description: True when the post is live, so a save (other than an unchanged one) changed the live page.

rebuild_queued.description: True when the save queued a site rebuild (only for published posts).

revision.description: The post's revision after this call; pass it as `revision` on the next edit.

title: Create or update a micropage post
